note: Source of truth for the program. The app reads this on launch. Edit here or in the app.

exercises.name: B-Stance Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Shin vertical at the top, pelvis tucked, ribs down. Left leg first. Mark your foot position.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.cue: Torso leaned 30-45 degrees forward. Left first.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Hamstring-dominant by design - don't chase glute feel here.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Abduction
exercises.cue: Torso leaned forward. Stop at 15, then add load.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Kickback
exercises.cue: Torso near parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cue: Back to 50 kg - your October number. Feet mid-platform, no lumbar rounding at the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cue: Back to 35 kg.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: LEFT SIDE ONLY. Bodyweight, no dumbbell. Stop 1-2 reps short.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Press
exercises.cue: Forefoot on the plate edge, knees soft, full heel sink, 2s pause. 45 kg.

exercises.name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
exercises.cue: 5-10 cm platform. Left first.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Bodyweight. Add reps 6 to 8 to 10 to 12 before any load. Shin vertical, pelvis tucked.

exercises.name: Kickstand RDL
exercises.cue: Back toe down for balance only, ~90% of the load through the front leg.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Abduction
exercises.cue: Same machine as Monday - higher reps here.

days.name: Posture
days.sub: Upper back · neck · rounded shoulders. 3x/week, chin tucks daily

exercises.name: Prone Y Raise
exercises.cue: Face down, thumbs up, chin tucked. Hold 3-5 s at the top, no shrug. Video: https://us.physitrack.com/home-exercise-video/shoulder-y-raise-in-prone

exercises.name: Prone T Raise
exercises.cue: Forehead on a towel, squeeze shoulder blades. Hold 3-5 s, don't arch the low back. Video: https://library.theprehabguys.com/vimeo-video/prone-ts/

exercises.name: Band Row
exercises.cue: Elbows back, shoulder blades together, neck long. Cable row at the gym works too. Video: https://us.physitrack.com/home-exercise-video/resisted-low-rows

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.cue: Rope or band at face height, pull to the face and apart. Band pull-aparts as a swap. Video: https://learn.athleanx.com/articles/do-this-home-exercise-every-day-no-equipment

exercises.name: Chin Tuck
exercises.cue: Do this one DAILY. Draw chin straight back (double chin), hold 10 s each rep. Video: https://us.physitrack.com/home-exercise-video/chin--tuck

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Minor Stretch
exercises.cue: Hold 30 s per set. Stop if the arm tingles. Video: https://library.theprehabguys.com/vimeo-video/pec-minor-stretch-doorway/

exercises.name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
exercises.cue: Roller across the upper back, extend on the exhale, move up segment by segment, 1-2 min. Chin tucked, low back neutral. Video: https://ie.physitrack.com/home-exercise-video/thoracic-extension-using-a-foam-roller
